# The Wayfinders' Register

*Game data as of 1 May 310.*

<!-- Generated by build_wiki.py. Edit the lore file, not this page. -->

The Wayfinders classify every world by what it would cost to settle, measured by colony cost for the Senaveil.

| Class | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Open world | colony cost 0: settlers need nothing |
| Fair world | colony cost up to 2.0 |
| Hard world | colony cost over 2.0, up to 4.0 |
| Sealed world | colony cost over 4.0: habitable only under domes |
| Barred world | colony cost N/A: no colony possible |
| Wellhead | a gas giant with surveyed Sorium, for fuel harvesting |
| Prospect | an extra tag for a surveyed body holding 100,000 t or more of a mineral at accessibility 0.5 or better |
